editor.label: Editor view
editor.lossy: Opened as source, because formatting would change the text.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Reusable guides the agent loads when needed: from the library, shipped with it, or learned by itself.
skills.loadNameHint: How the agent loads this skill
skills.pendingTitle: A change is waiting for you
skills.pendingText: On {when} the agent proposed a new version. It only applies once you accept it.
skills.runtimeSkill: This skill is part of the agent's basic equipment. You can switch it on and off.
skills.noContent: The content of this skill is not available yet.

emptyHint.assigned: Add skills from the library or let the agent learn on its own.
emptyHint.library: You create new skills in the skill library.
emptyHint.proposals: New or changed skills the agent proposes appear here.
emptyHint.archive: Skills that you or the tidy-up put away can be found here again.

skills.proposalsTitle: {count, plural, one {# proposal is waiting for you} other {# proposals are waiting for you}}
skills.proposalsText: The agent proposed new or changed skills.
skills.libraryHint: Skills of the library apply to every agent you assign them to.

history.title: Versions of the skill
history.empty: This skill has no history yet.

action.archiveUnused: Archived after a long time unused

memory.title: Memory
memory.approvalOn: Changes the agent makes to its memory wait for your approval; until then the approved version applies.
memory.approvalOff: The agent changes its memory itself. Every version is kept under "Versions".
memory.pendingTitle: {count, plural, one {# change is waiting for approval} other {# changes are waiting for approval}}
memory.pendingText: The agent wants to change something in its memory.
memory.notEditable: This agent only reports its memory; it can change it itself.

memory.title: What the agent remembers
memory.hint: Experience, rules and hints it has at hand in every conversation.

user.title: What the agent knows about you
user.hint: Your name, your preferences and how you like to work.

memory.clearBody: The agent loses these entries. Earlier versions are kept under "Versions".
memory.truncated: Only the beginning of the file is shown.

notes.title: Daily notes
notes.emptyHint: What the agent writes down during the day appears here, sorted by day.

facts.emptyHint: What the agent files as established knowledge appears here, with the trust it has earned.
facts.removeBody: "{fact}" is hidden and no longer used.

versions.title: Versions of the memory
versions.emptyHint: Every version of the memory is kept here, with the difference to the one before.

file.user: What the agent knows about you

soul.title: Personality
soul.hint: Who the agent is and how it presents itself (SOUL). It comes first in every conversation.
soul.placeholder: Tone, attitude and principles of the agent …

own.title: Instructions
own.hint: What this agent should and should not do. They add to the personality.

files.title: More instruction files
files.hint: Additional Markdown files the agent gets along with its instructions.
files.name: Name of the new file
files.invalid: Letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore only; separate folders with "/".

inherited.title: Inherits from
inherited.hint: This also applies to the agent; you can only read it here.
inherited.follows: The instructions follow the template whenever it changes.
inherited.differs: This copy differs from the template.

learning.readOnly: Only members who may edit agents can change this.

learn.title: Learning
learn.hint: Saved with the agent and applies from the next conversation.

learning.label: Learn skills from experience
learning.hint: The agent keeps what it learns at work: new skills and entries in its memory. The cost counts towards its usage. Off: it saves nothing new.

curator.label: Tidy up skills
curator.hint: Duplicate skills are merged and long-unused ones archived. Pinned skills stay untouched; nothing is lost.

memoryApproval.label: Show changes first
memoryApproval.hint: New or changed skills and memory entries wait for your approval instead of applying at once.

reflection.label: Look back after runs
reflection.hint: Right after a run the agent notes in a short follow-up what it learned from it.

chats.label: Look back after chats
chats.hint: When a chat rests for a while, the agent notes what it learned about you and your wishes.

dream.title: Dreaming
dream.hint: Tidying up in the background, without you doing anything.
dream.label: Consolidate at night
dream.text: Every night the agent moves what lasts from the daily notes into its memory and drops duplicates.

limits.title: Size limits
limits.hint: How much text each part of the context may hold. The model only sees what is beyond it shortened. Adjustable later.
